description: This file declares a gRPC service handler function within the 'cuttlefish' namespace that processes command requests received via gRPC. It includes a utility result type and defines a single function 'HandleCmds' which takes a socket path, command string, and arguments, returning a Result-wrapped string.

methods.name: HandleCmds
methods.description: Declares a function to handle commands received over gRPC, returning a Result containing a string.

calls: Result<std::string> HandleCmds(const std::string&, const std::string&, const std::vector<std::string>&)
